slides.title: Fall is here and my entryway is a boot graveyard. Finds that fixed it.
A boot tray by the door
slides.body: Wet boots go on the tray, not across the floor. One clear spot means no puddle trail into the kitchen.

slides.title: Over-the-door hooks
slides.body: Coats hang at grab height instead of on the chair. No closet door to open first.

slides.title: A bin for hats and gloves
slides.body: One open basket, no lid. Toss in, grab out. Matching pairs is a spring problem.

slides.title: An umbrella stand
slides.body: Wet umbrellas stop living open in the hallway. It drips where it's meant to drip.

slides.title: A sticky-note mirror spot
slides.body: A little mirror with a ledge for keys and a note. Last look, last reminder, out the door.

slides.title: If putting it away takes two steps, it's staying on the floor.
